title: glechoma hederacea var. micrantha
intro: Glechoma hederacea var. micrantha, commonly known as Creeping Jenny, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Jenny include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it useful for treating various ailments. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
